steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in service mode
steps.body: Service mode entered. Use Light key (SW2) to navigate to the step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use SW2 to advance steps; SW5 toggles loads.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 9
steps.body: Use Light key (SW2) to advance until Freezer TEMP LEDs show step 9 (Damper open). Wait at least 1 second between key presses.

steps.title: Monitor damper open
steps.body: At step 9, damper opens. Verify cold air baffle/damper moves to open position. Step 10 closes damper automatically.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 9, damper opens. Verify cold air baffle/damper moves to open position. Step 10 closes damper automatically.

steps.title: Damper opens
steps.body: Does damper move to fully open position?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does damper move to fully open position?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Damper stuck — check stepper motor P70/P11 or linkage.

steps.title: Replace damper assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace electric air baffle/damper when it fails step 9.

steps.title: Damper verified
steps.oemOutcome: Damper opens correctly in service step 9.
